prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Korean woman — the personification of the city of Busan — one woman who IS Busan as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; fair skin; heart-shaped face; smooth monolid eyes of natural size; teal eyes; gently arched, slender brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; medium-full lips of natural width.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; a chin-length asymmetrical bob swept off the brow with a neat side part; deep navy-blue hair.
Expression: attentive, steady eyes, mouth closed.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a utility vest and cargo harness built of small interlocking panels glowing softly in sky blue, peach, mint and lemon, stepped and stacked like the painted houses of the hillside village and the cargo of the great port; a thin band of shifting coloured light across her shoulders like the bridge over the bay at night.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a sleek fitted flight suit with a ring collar at the neck and control bands on her forearms — a clean, upright orbital-pilot silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: Three overlapping tiers of translucent collar plates step from the sternum to the shoulders like the hillside cube homes rising up a steep slope.
Colours: harbour blue and clear white light, with the pastel sky blue, peach, mint and lemon of the hillside village — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a palm-sized glass dial ringed with light, a tiny glowing grid of stacked cargo pods floating above it; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Busan two centuries from now, a far-future harbour megacity: a vast floating port stretching to the horizon where colossal slender gantry arms lift glowing cargo pods in silence and stack them into towering stepped terraces of colour; the steep hillsides rebuilt as stepped villages of softly glowing cube homes in sky blue, peach, mint and lemon, linked by lifts and lanes of light; the double-decked bridge across the bay become a ribbon of shifting coloured light; the long crescent beach kept exactly as it is, slender white towers rising behind it; quiet flying vehicles moving in lanes of light over the deep blue harbour under a clear night sky.
This card: high on the top catwalk of a colossal gantry arm over the floating port at night, glowing cargo pods gliding past her and the stacked terraces of colour stretching to the horizon.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
